raw_comment: I noticed that certain regions, like Texas, are experiencing more droughts than other areas. I also see several areas with less drought than other areas. Many states don't have extreme droughts and are either abnormally dry or dry. I wonder why there are white parts. I wonder why these droughts are happening and how we could prevent them from happening again. This relates to my community because it has affected my way of living since I live in the US. This also shows how climate change and global warming affect our community and nation. "Is the US drying up?"
